regions.name: Northern & central unimodal areas
regions.where: Everything north of roughly 7.5 N: Alibori, Atacora, Borgou, Donga, Collines (purple on the top locator map)
regions.notes: Rainy shading ends mid-Oct. Main cereals mid-Oct to Dec; yams mid-Aug to Sep. Cotton harvest drawn as Jan + Nov-Dec, merged. Yam planting drawn as Dec + an unlabelled first-half-Jan stub, merged. Cotton and soy linked to the rains because their planting bar sits in May-Jul.

regions.name: Southern bimodal areas
regions.where: The south below roughly 7.5 N: Zou, Plateau, Couffo, Mono, Atlantique, Oueme, Littoral (purple on the bottom locator map)
regions.notes: Rainy Season 1 Mar to mid-Jul, Rainy Season 2 Sep to mid-Nov; lean Apr to mid-Jun. S1 maize mid-Jun to Jul; S2 rice mid-Feb to Apr; S1 cassava and vegetables drawn in Jan + Dec pieces, merged. S2 green harvest (Oct) skipped. S2 planting has two bars: mid-Sep to mid-Oct, and mid-Nov to Jan (Dec + Jan pieces merged).

assign.method: Locator maps split the country at about 7.5 N (Collines / Zou-Plateau line); departments assigned by that line.

transcriber_notes: 2024+ template: element edges sit on a half-month grid; a month that is exactly half covered counts (>= half rule). Half months counted: north rainy Oct, maize planting May, yam planting Jan, yam harvest Aug, main cereals Oct, rice planting Oct & Nov; south rainy Jul & Nov, lean Jun, S1 planting Mar & Apr, S2 planting Sep, Oct & Nov, S1 maize Jun, S2 rice Feb. North rice planting (mid-Oct to mid-Nov, after the rains) is on the image as drawn but its season is unclear, so it is unlinked.
